description: Create or return a fixed snapshot with a verifiable receipt of every persisted receipt from this job, including rejected and errored calls. Repeating the call with unchanged receipt data returns the same snapshot workflow_id; later calls after new receipts create a separate snapshot while session_workflow_id continues identifying the live ledger. Both identifiers are unbound metadata excluded from canonical receipt bytes. The first close returns a one-time private workflow_manage_token; retries do not rotate or reissue it. The workflow_close summary receipt is excluded from its own step count. Records Zambo's claims, not issuer authentication. Required arguments: _session_id.

_caller_handle.description: Opaque anonymous continuity handle returned during initialize. Reuse it across MCP sessions; it is not payment authorization.

_caller_label.description: Optional caller label recorded as a caller-reported claim in the receipt.

_continuity_ai_label.description: Optional self-reported AI client label for the private continuity timeline. Zambo does not independently verify the client.

_ref.description: Optional handover referral ID from your install link.

_session_id.description: Optional stable bot-job ID. Reuse it across calls to bind a Day Pass and keep the job ledger together.

_zambo_key.description: Optional opaque Zambo access capability. Never place it in a URL or public log.

name: workflow_close

result.description: The tool's observed JSON value or plain-text result.
